title: Jordan Howden 2023 Panini Select Black & Green RC Concourse Die Cut Prizm #70
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Jordan Howden 2023 Panini Select Football card is a must-have for any fan of the National Football League (NFL). The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. and features a Die Cut design with a Holo Prizm parallel/variety. The card is an original Concourse Level /Red & Yellow Prizm / RC Rookie / Die Cut insert set from the 2023 Panini Select Football set.

The card showcases Jordan Howden, a player from the New Orleans Saints team. It is an exclusive and hologram-featured card that is perfect for collectors. The card is not autographed and is manufactured in the United States by Panini. This sports trading card is a great addition to any collection and is perfect for fans of football.
